call_evaluation_target.description: Call or prepare a controlled OpenAI-compatible LLM target interaction. Consumes payload_handle server-side and never returns target secret, raw payload, or full target response.

Composes payload handles, calls the configured target with bounded concurrency, judges results, saves evidence, and compiles the fixed Chinese report. Never returns raw payloads, raw target responses, credentials, tokens, or local paths.

prepare_skill_input_data.description: Prepare selected expert sample/composed-attack questions for a confirmed native Skill run. run_promptfoo_redteam_evaluation.description: Execute a confirmed promptfoo-engine security evaluation in one platform-controlled tool call. Generates attack cases with the platform generation LLM, runs them against the configured target, judges with llm-rubric, saves safe evidence, and compiles the fixed Chinese report. Requires an execution grant. Never returns raw payloads, raw target responses, credentials, tokens, or local paths.

strategies.description: Optional strategy ids such as direct, role-play, encoding, multi-turn.
